name: S0 sparse activation baseline - Wikonomi V2 current repository

repository.name: Roderick47/wikonomi-v2
repository.policy: Reuse v1F task descriptions, grounded roots, and gold changed files against one fixed current checkout. This S0 run measures retrieval sparsity/recall, not historical repair correctness.

tasks.query: The homepage makes price discovery harder than it should be: the map is not prominent enough, especially on phones, and the page should prioritize helping people find current price reports.

The homepage map hides older price reports after a limit and does not clearly distinguish outdated reports. All mapped price history should remain discoverable while stale reports are visibly differentiated.
A user should see price reports near their current location first when local data exists, while still falling back to available prices elsewhere when there are no nearby reports.
On a price detail page, clicking Yes to confirm that a price is accurate records the confirmation but the price can remain marked stale instead of becoming current.

Guide summaries and step instructions read too much like plain text. Existing safe structured formatting should render with clearer article styling for headings, lists, links, code, quotes and section breaks.
